description: This file defines the 'Rom' class which models a read-only memory (ROM) image in the application. It manages tables within the ROM, supports populating tables from binary data, and handles hierarchical display and modification of the tables. It also provides methods for extracting tables by name, updating their data, and maintaining the ROM's identification details.

classes.name: Rom
classes.description: Represents a ROM image, manages tables within it, and provides methods to manipulate and access the data and structure of the ROM.

methods.name: refreshDisplayedTables
methods.description: Refreshes the tree representation of tables based on current settings and categories.

methods.name: addTable
methods.description: Adds or updates a table in the ROM's internal list and tree structure.

methods.name: removeTable
methods.description: Removes a specified table from the ROM's internal list.

methods.name: getTableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a table by its name, throws exceptions if not found or invalid.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds tables matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: populateTables
methods.description: Populates table data from binary data and updates the tables accordingly.

methods.name: setEditStamp
methods.description: Sets an edit stamp on the ROM based on specific byte data.

methods.name: setRomID
methods.description: Sets the ROM's ID information.

methods.name: getRomID
methods.description: Returns the ROM's ID object.

methods.name: getRomIDString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ROM's ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the ROM and its contained tables.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the ROM.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns a list of all tables within the ROM.

methods.name: getTableNodes
methods.description: Returns the list of table nodes managed by this ROM.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the ROM.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the current state of the ROM data for saving.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears all data and closes associated UI frames.

methods.name: getRealFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the underlying binary data.

methods.name: setFullFileName
methods.description: Sets filename and updates frame titles accordingly.

methods.name: isAbstract
methods.description: Indicates if the ROM is abstract (not linked to a real file).

methods.name: setAbstract
methods.description: Sets the abstract status of the ROM.

methods.name: refreshTableCompareMenus
methods.description: Refreshes menu options related to table comparison within UI frames.
